name: ARISA-MLOps-devcontainer
postCreateCommand: pip install --no-cache-dir -e . && pip install psycopg2-binary boto3
postStartCommand: bash -c 'if [ -n "$MLFLOWDBENDPOINT" ]; then echo "Starting MLflow with AWS RDS backend..."; mlflow server --backend-store-uri postgresql://$MLFLOWDBUSERNAME:$MLFLOWDBPASS@$MLFLOWDBENDPOINT:$MLFLOWDBPORT/$MLFLOWDB --default-artifact-root s3://$ARTIFACT_BUCKET/mlartifacts --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5000 & else echo "Starting MLflow with local SQLite backend..."; mkdir -p /workspace/mlruns && mlflow ui --backend-store-uri sqlite:////workspace/mlruns/mlflow.db --default-artifact-root file:///workspace/mlruns/mlartifacts --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5000 & fi'

MLFLOWDBUSERNAME.description: Username for authenticating the MLflow backend db connection.

MLFLOWDBPASS.description: Password for authenticating the MLflow backend db connection.

MLFLOWDBENDPOINT.description: Endpoint where the MLflow backend is publicly available.

MLFLOWDBPORT.description: Port where the MLflow backend db is exposed.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: AWS access key for S3 artifact storage.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: AWS secret key for S3 artifact storage.

ARTIFACT_BUCKET.description: S3 bucket name for MLflow artifacts (e.g., heart-disease-mlflow-artifacts).
